add_library(rm690a0 STATIC rm690a0.c)
add_library(linux::rm690a0 ALIAS rm690a0)
target_include_directories(rm690a0 PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_link_libraries(rm690a0 PUBLIC proj::options)
target_compile_options(rm690a0 PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
add_library(lv_display STATIC lv_display.c)
add_library(linux::display ALIAS lv_display)
target_link_libraries(lv_display PUBLIC linux::rm690a0 lvgl::lvgl)
target_compile_options(lv_display PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
